title: Package manifest
description: Identity, version and requirements of a package (manifest.json).

version.description: Version constraint, e.g. ">=1.0.0", "^1.2.0" or ">=1.0.0, <2.0.0". Omitted means any version.

kernelPackage.description: Marks a package embedded in the kernel. Such packages are installed only by the kernel itself; packages from directories or archives must not set it.

capabilities.description: Capabilities beyond computing and the database that the code uses through native methods.

languageVersion.description: Version of the language of the source files in src/. Required when the package has source files.
